Refund Policy

1. Welcome

Welcome to Rifat Academy! We appreciate your interest in our courses. Our goal is to provide a positive and valuable learning experience through our courses and educational materials.

2. Refund Policy

All course purchases are non-refundable, whether paid online or offline. If you encounter any issues with a course, our support team will assist you to resolve them, but money will not be refunded under any circumstances.

3. Course Exchange Policy

We do not offer course exchanges. Once a course is purchased, it cannot be exchanged for another course or service. We encourage students to carefully select courses before purchase.

4. Special Refund Circumstances

In rare or exceptional cases where a refund is approved, it may take 7 to 10 business days to process the refund. Approval is entirely at the discretion of Rifat Academy.

5. Thank You

Thank you for understanding and respecting our refund policies. Our priority is to ensure a smooth and beneficial learning experience for all students.
